additional_info.subject: 0431614 - ID0431614-DC/Si-D/-NZ-[MP / P3 170000341] CHAdeMo Cable Replacement CRM:00472000318
additional_info.body:
Dear Liz,
There was 2 versions for CHAdeMO cables in our portfolio. 200A that is the one you have originally installed on you charger and the 125A that you have ordered now. The main difference between the cables except from the max current, is that the 200A cable have 2 temperature sensors on the plug to measure the temperature on DC+ and DC- pins. The CHAdeMO 125A doesn't have those temperature sensors. That explains why you have 4 cables less.
It's possible to replace one for another but some actions must be done.
Image below shows the schematic from CHAdeMO you have installed on the charger.
The Image below shows the CHAdeMO 125A connections.
Note: All activity must be done with the charger OFF and disconnect from the grid following the 5 safety rules.
As you can see you have 2 signals less (4 wires). Connect all the other cables and leave empty the missing entries.
Check the state monitor KF13, on the front and right side, open the transparent cover and remove the front black plastic with a small screwdriver. Then change the configuration from 200A to 125A according the picture below.
For the charger configuration it's necessary to change also the cable type on SCB.
If you have no access to SCB (Siemens Backend to manage all Sicharge D chargers), let me know and I can do it. For that I will need the charger powered on and online.
Let me know if you have additional questions.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
